name: Nagakute
intro_en: Nagakute, just east of Nagoya, is home to the Aichi Expo Memorial Park — the site of the 2005 World Expo, now a vast green space of forest trails, lawns and play areas. Ghibli Park is located inside the park grounds.
Beyond the park, the town is a relaxed, residential place with plenty of space to breathe, making it a good half-day escape from the city.
getting_there_en: Take the Higashiyama subway line to Fujigaoka, then change to the Linimo maglev line for Ai·Chikyuhaku-Kinen-Koen Station.
